name: np_siren_second
character: The second cruiser: a two-tone 435/580 Hz hi-lo at 55 cycles a minute while it joins, then a fast yelp from 700 to 1500 Hz at 240 cycles a minute once the roadblock is close; it never shares a pitch with the first.
note: The European two-tone pattern (435/580 Hz at 50-60 per minute) and the NIJ yelp (240 per minute); the car switches pattern at the roadblock. ESTIMATE: the two patterns and their levels are starting values; the hi-lo pair is from a patent summary, not read in full
